data.text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY
PROJECTS COMMISSIONING IN THE FCT
Day 15 - Wednesday 2nd July, 2025

Commissioning of the dualized and upgraded Ushafa to War College/Army Check Point roads and other ancillary roads in Bwari Area Council at Ushafa roundabout.

Vehicular traffic along the entire road will be managed to allow for seamless movement of dignitaries, invited guests and the motoring public. As such, traffic may be stopped intermittently for movement of dignitaries heading to the venue.

Trading and other sundry nuisances will be prohibited along the road corridor, especially the Dutse market area and other locations.

Traffic personnel and security agents will be deployed accordingly by 7am.

Signed
Head Traffic, DRTS
